ana (eng-releases): deploy-bot flagged an anomaly in post-deploy synthetic checks for /chat-sim, canary 316
deploy-bot: Canary run=316, failures=5/20, error=embed-lookup schema mismatch (5xx). logs: https://logs.redwood/c/316
mike (oncall): seeing odd traffic shape in the synth — long prompts with lots of brackets, not our usual shorter samples. could be tokenizer edge-case
elin (sre): p95 latency jumped on canary hosts and a few 504s from inference-proxy around 15:03 UTC
carla (eng): rollback during the change window is messy. can we pin the route to the previous model-variant while we triage?
nana (typo fix): (ignore)
nana removed, continuing
ana: oops wrong keyboard — ignore last line
ana fixed, continue
ana not a participant, ignore
ana (eng-releases): sorry accidental messages, yes pining sounds right
carla (eng): proposal: pin chat-sim -> model:v2026-03-20-stable, run targeted replay of failing synth set, then decide
mike (oncall): +1 pin. question: will cache warmup from pinning create bigger p95 blips?
elin (sre): cache warmup will add some tail latency but much smaller than the current 504s. recommend pin now and run focused replays
carla (eng): kicking off replay with the failing payloads now. curl example for reproducer:
```
curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.internal/v1/simulate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"route":"/chat-sim","prompt":"<very long user prompt with brackets and emojis>"}'
```
mike (oncall): deploy-bot, set rollout hold and pin route
deploy-bot: Rollout hold applied by @mike; route chat-sim pinned to model:v2026-03-20-stable; announcement sent to #eng-releases and #eng-oncall
ana (eng-releases): add a short entry to release notes: "canary 316 hold: pinned route chat-sim to v2026-03-20-stable while we triage synth failures"
carla (eng): replay logs show tokenization differences between v2026-03-20 and v2026-03-22-build (new tokenizer tweaks). likely subword split mismatch causing embed lookup errors
elin (sre): if tokenizer change is root cause, reverting the tokenizer config (hotpatch) is lower-risk than full model rollback. can we hotpatch tonight?
mike (oncall): ops says hotpatching tokenizer config is doable in ~45m. any objections to doing this inside the current change window? :thinking:
nana again glitch ignored
ana (eng-releases): no objections, prefer hotpatch then validate. keep hold until synth suite passes
deploy-bot: Hotpatch job queued: job-8842 (tokenizer-config-revert). ETA ~42m. Notifying #eng-oncall and #eng-releases
carla (eng): after hotpatch we'll run the failing synth subset first, then full synthetic pass. if pass -> lift hold and resume canary. if fail -> rollback model and open a postmortem
mike (oncall): I'll update the release notes and tag related PRs with the hold reason. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
